title: Clicker Inc.～世代交代で目指す巨大企業～

title: SCP Loop
shortDescription: You are a SCP Foundation employee. One day, you find yourself going through corridor, which suddenly starts to repeat itself. Explore SCP 970 and maybe you can escape...
aboutTheGame: About this game SCP Loop is a horror spot the difference game, based on SCP 970, based on SCP Foundation Story You are a SCP Foundation employee. While being send to find Dr. Alto Clef, you find yourself trapped in an never ending corridors of SCP 970. Further you wander, more insane things get. Your objective is simple, escape as fast as you can. Gameplay SCP Loop takes between 30-55 minutes to complete, with multiple endings. You goal is to find differences in iterations of corridors.
